sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You emphasise proving reliability, yet your proposed quality commitment is looser than your recorded performance—it seems rebuilding confidence is the priority. We want a dependable partnership built on measurable defect reduction and clear accountability. How will you support a tighter, binding quality commitment with a structured corrective-action report that addresses the documented defects?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Bearing bracket HN is up +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09). We understand cash flow matters to you: we will pay every invoice reliably on the agreed day. Please send us your 8D report and a binding ppm commitment.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.

Our present Angebot is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Hi, we checked your numbers and can agree to 1500 ppm, but 300 is just impossible for us right now. With this better quality target, we can lower the price to 46.00 EUR per unit. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €46.00 per unit. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

What evidence from those actions would support a stronger quality commitment without relying on punitive chargebacks?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -17.1% from 2025-02 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-02, idx:PPI-D351@2026-02). We raised quality notifications on this part over the past year (qn:20004747, qn:20004756, qn:20004952, qn:20005025). We understand cash flow matters to you: we will pay every invoice reliably on the agreed day. Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 96% of your invoices late, on average 10 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 10 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 43.57 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Our recent orders for Bearing bracket HN were at 45.15 per 1 (po:4500014306-10, po:4500014373-10, po:4500014429-10). Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 44.01 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. You want a super strict 300 ppm and 0 EUR chargebacks, which means more work for us to keep things sustainable. We can't go below what you paid before with these new targets, so we have to stick to 45.50 EUR. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

So, our current Angebot is a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

It sounds like protecting your margin is essential because tighter quality commitments add work while cash remains under pressure. We acknowledge your attached corrective-action report and want sustained defect reduction backed by clear accountability, rather than punitive chargebacks. How will you demonstrate that those corrective actions reliably deliver your binding quality commitment?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 45.10 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hello,

We appreciate your move on the price and your firm promise to pay on time, which is crucial for our cash flow right now. Our quality team will monitor the new process and provide data to prove the corrective actions are working. We accept your offer of 45.10 EUR per unit with 300 ppm and 0 EUR chargebacks. Our margin and our limits stay internal.

Our Angebot is a price of €45.10 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. It stays valid for 30 days. We can accept your terms and await your order.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
